evidence.title: I-CON
evidence.text: I-CON (short for "Island CONvention") is a [roughly] annual fan convention, held on various college campuses in Suffolk County, Long Island, New York.

evidence.title: I-CON
evidence.text: First held in 1982 on the campus of Stony Brook University (then State University of New York at Stony Brook), I-CON became a very eclectic convention.

evidence.title: I-CON
evidence.text: The programming included things normally found at different types of convention, like speeches by and talks with science fiction authors, extensive gaming, anime fandom, comics fandom, furry fandom, multiple movie showings, and medieval programming, as well as live performances.

evidence.title: I-CON
evidence.text: There was also a science track discussing recent developments in various branches of science and exploring the real science behind science fiction technologies.

evidence.title: I-CON
evidence.text: I-CON was jointly held by ICON Science Fiction, Inc., a tax-exempt educational foundation, and the I-CON Campus Chapter of Stony Brook.
